title: Speech Recording
description: Defines the required metadata for every individual speech recording in the Sauti Labs platform, per ADR-0002. Each recording references a speech-source entry (its origin) and, where applicable, a speaker_id from speaker-registry (never a real identity).

source_id.description: Cross-reference to the speech-source entry this recording was derived from.

speaker_id.description: Cross-reference to a pseudonymous speaker-registry entry. Omit entirely if speaker is unknown or not applicable (e.g. synthetic audio, broadcast with unidentified speakers).

language.description: ISO code of the language spoken in this recording.

checksum_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the audio file, for version integrity verification.

version.description: Semantic version, e.g. '1.0.0'. A new version is created for any re-processing (denoising, re-segmentation), never an overwrite.

technical_quality_score.description: Automated, objective quality score (e.g. from silence/clipping/SNR detection). Distinct from annotation-framework's human-reviewed quality_score - these measure different things and must not be conflated.
